parsedVerdict.reasoning: This file is an in-memory persistence adapter that implements the domain port SubscriptionRepository. All of its responsibilities belong to infrastructure: it stores Subscription objects in a Map, looks them up by id, saves them, and creates storage-specific ids (the 'mem-' prefix). The activeFor method filters on customerId and state === 'active'. That is the query the port method asks for, not a business rule. It doesn't decide what makes a subscription active and it changes no domain state. The file has no domain rules, application orchestration or transport logic.
